audit_items.proof_trace: FlashLoan<MarketType, CoinType> declares no abilities (no copy/drop/store), making it a Move hot potato enforced at the VM bytecode-verifier level — the transaction is aborted if the value is not consumed before it ends. The sole consumer is repay_flash_loan (market.move:836) which destructures the struct inside the module (fields are not public) and asserts coin.value() == principal + fee with fee > 0, guaranteeing amount_repaid > principal.
